pages.title: Chibi Frieren with a Cherry on Her Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Frieren balances a cherry on her head in this printable coloring page, with twin ponytails, long pointed ears, and large teardrop earrings. A leaf extends from the cherry's curved stem above her hair. Her short cape, striped top, layered skirt, and small boots form broad, separate areas on the otherwise plain coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chibi Frieren Sitting in a Cat Onesie Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Frieren sits in a cat onesie in this printable coloring page, with a hood shaped like a cat's face and one sleeve raised. Paw pads decorate the feet beneath the row of round buttons. A curved costume tail and four sparkles surround the seated figure, while her pointed ears and earrings remain visible.

pages.title: Frieren Portrait Framed by Large Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Large flowers frame Frieren's portrait in this printable coloring page, surrounding her twin ponytails, pointed ears, and long earrings above a high buttoned collar. Rounded petals and small stamens create finer sections around the face. The flowing hair and simple clothing panels leave broader areas within the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frieren Looking Over Her Shoulder with Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren looks over her shoulder in this printable coloring page, wearing a strapless dress while long ponytails curl around her back and bare shoulders. Clusters of flowers border the lower portrait, with loose petals beside her head. The open dress panels and flowing hair contrast with the smaller petals and teardrop earrings.

pages.title: Frieren Smiling with Closed Eyes in a Frame Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren smiles with closed eyes in this printable coloring page, with her long twin ponytails, pointed ears, and teardrop earrings inside a rectangular border. Two hands enter from the right beside her head and beneath her chin. Her high collar, striped top, and bordered cape add separate sections beneath the portrait.

pages.title: Frieren Portrait Framed by Heart Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Two hands form a heart around Frieren's face in this printable coloring page, with their fingertips meeting above her hair and thumbs curving below her chin. Her head tilts within the opening, framed by long ponytails and pointed ears. Teardrop earrings and a high collar add smaller enclosed details beneath the face.

pages.title: Frieren Framing Her Face with Her Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren frames her face with her hands in this printable coloring page, holding one near her forehead and the other across the space below her chin. Her long ponytails extend around the raised arms and wide cuffs. Bordered cape panels, a striped top, and a belt add clothing details beneath the pose.

pages.title: Frieren Blowing a Kiss with a Floating Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren blows a kiss from her open palm in this printable coloring page, with a floating heart beside her ponytail and scattered circles behind her. Her puckered lips and raised hand establish the gesture. The wide cuff, high collar, long hair, and simple rectangular border leave larger areas around the smaller facial details.

pages.title: Frieren Portrait with an Ornate Floral Border Coloring Page
pages.description: An ornate floral border surrounds Frieren's portrait in this printable coloring page, with curling leaves at each corner and small circles behind her long hair. She turns slightly to one side in her high collar and short cape. Long earrings, a round shoulder clasp, and narrow clothing bands add details within the frame.

pages.title: Frieren with Flowing Hair and a Magic Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren holds a magic staff diagonally in this printable coloring page, with flowing ponytails, a flared skirt, and her other hand resting at her hip. The staff's crescent head surrounds a large round orb above her shoulder. Small circles and irregular outlined shapes fill the border around her cape, belt, and boots.

pages.title: Frieren Peeking Out of a Forest Mimic Chest Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren peeks out of a mimic chest in this printable coloring page, gripping the front rim beneath a raised lid lined with large pointed teeth. Tall trees and bushes surround the chest beside a winding forest path. Metal bands, a prominent keyhole, and rows of teeth create separate shapes around her face.

pages.title: Chibi Frieren on a Treasure Chest with Her Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Frieren sits on a treasure chest in this printable coloring page, resting her cheek on one hand while her crescent staff stands beside her. Coins are scattered around the chest's base beneath her dangling boots. Long ponytails, a round staff orb, and the chest's bands and keyhole add distinct sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Chibi Frieren Holding a Mug at Her Laptop Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Frieren holds a mug beside an open laptop in this printable coloring page, with a closed book and ribbon bookmark on the desk. Her eyes are closed above rounded cheeks and a small smile. Pinned notes, a chair back, and the book's floral cover add details around the character and computer.

pages.title: Fern Hugging Frieren Around Her Shoulders Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern hugs Frieren around her shoulders in this printable coloring page, standing behind her with both arms crossing in front of Frieren's high collar. Their faces sit one above the other between the sides of a brick doorway. Fern's straight bangs and Frieren's pointed ears and earrings distinguish the two figures.

pages.title: Chibi Fern Holding Her Staff Among Butterflies Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Fern holds her staff among butterflies in this printable coloring page, with one butterfly perched near its tip and others surrounding her long dress. Her straight bangs and long hair frame the rounded face. Wrapped bands, a dangling cord, small sparkles, and wide cape panels add separate details around the staff and figure.

pages.title: Chibi Frieren Holding Her Staff Among Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Frieren holds a crescent staff in this printable coloring page, tilting her head beside scattered flowers and loose petals around her long ponytails. Her boots cross beneath a short skirt and bordered cape. The staff's large round orb, small earrings, and broad clothing panels offer a mix of larger and smaller enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Frieren Smiling in a Scarf Among Snowflakes Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren smiles in a scarf in this printable coloring page, with closed eyes, both hands beside her cheeks, and outlined snowflakes around her head. Mountains and evergreen trees extend across the snowy background. Her long earrings, wide cuffs, layered scarf, and twin ponytails add larger shapes in front of the finer landscape details.

pages.title: Frieren Wearing a Maid Dress with a Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren wears a maid dress with a bow in this printable coloring page, tilting her head while keeping both arms behind her back beside a small heart. Round buttons run down the fitted front above a layered, ruffled skirt. Long twin ponytails and plain sleeves leave broad areas around the smaller collar and bow.

pages.title: Frieren Touching Noses with a Fluffy Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren touches noses with a fluffy cat in this printable coloring page, holding it close while its front paws extend toward her shoulder and chest. Her hand supports the cat beneath its thick fur. Leafy branches, long whiskers, a striped cuff, and Frieren's pointed ear frame the close view of their faces.

pages.title: Fern Aiming Her Magic Staff Among Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern aims her magic staff toward the viewer in this printable coloring page, standing among flowers while loose petals drift around her long flowing hair. The enlarged staff tip fills the upper left above her gripping hands. Wrapped bands, robe buttons, and a large circular outline behind her head add details throughout the scene.

pages.title: Frieren Holding Her Crescent Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren holds her crescent-topped staff in this printable coloring page, standing in her short cape, belted dress, and boots beside an ivy-covered stone arch. Long twin tails and pointed ears frame her face. The staff's round center, sleeve fastenings, and distant castle offer smaller details around the broad clothing sections.

pages.title: Frieren Casting Zoltraak with Her Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren casts Zoltraak from her crescent staff in this printable coloring page, bracing her boots apart as a pointed magical ray extends to the side. Both hands hold the diagonal shaft. Her flowing twin tails, cape panels, belt buckle, and the nearby ruined arch provide distinct sections across the action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frieren Creating a Field of Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren creates a field of flowers in this printable coloring page, extending one open hand while holding her staff beside a cluster of large blossoms. Curving magical trails and loose petals surround her cape and twin tails. Broad flower petals, leaf shapes, boots, and simple costume panels leave clearly separated areas to color.

pages.title: Chibi Frieren Sitting on Her Travel Trunk Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Frieren sits on her travel trunk in this printable coloring page, with her small boots together, hands resting beside her, and staff leaning nearby. Her oversized head, pointed ears, cape, and twin tails make the simplified character recognizable. Trunk latches, corner fittings, and a small ruined arch add enclosed details.

pages.title: Frieren in Her Winter Coat and Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren wears a long winter coat and scarf in this printable coloring page, holding her crescent staff beside a snow-covered wall and bare tree branches. Fluffy trim borders her collar, cuffs, and coat hem. Large coat panels contrast with the buttons, scarf fringes, staff ornaments, and simple patches of snow.

pages.title: Frieren Blowing a Kiss with a Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren blows a kiss from her raised palm in this printable coloring page, standing with her other hand lowered beside her belted dress and short cape. A small outlined heart floats near her face. Her twin tails, dangling earrings, sleeve fastenings, boots, and a distant stone arch complete the simple character scene.

pages.title: Frieren, Fern, and Eisen Finding a Grimoire Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren, Fern, and Eisen examine an open grimoire in this printable coloring page, gathering around a low stone pedestal beneath a ruined arch and tree. Frieren kneels beside the blank pages while Fern holds her staff behind her. Eisen's horned helmet, beard, armor, and axe add contrasting shapes to the group coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frieren Reading an Ancient Grimoire Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren reads an ancient grimoire at a desk in this printable coloring page, resting both hands beside its open pages while seated on a simple chair. Her staff leans nearby, and a small shelf holds books and a bottle. The blank pages, broad dress panels, twin tails, and visible boots provide varied coloring areas.

pages.title: Frieren Facing Aura and Her Magic Scales Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren faces Aura in this printable coloring page, holding her crescent staff as the horned demon raises a balanced scale with two hanging pans between them. Curved magical trails separate the two figures. Aura's braids, long layered dress, scale chains, and pointed horns contrast with Frieren's short cape and boots.

pages.title: Frieren Flying Above a Mountain Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren flies above a mountain path in this printable coloring page, holding her staff upright as her hair and cape sweep outward around her gently bent legs. One open hand extends to the side. Sparse mountain contours, rocks, and bushes keep attention on the elf's flowing silhouette and broad costume sections.

pages.title: Frieren Wearing a Simple Flower Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren wears a flower crown in this printable coloring page, holding her crescent staff with both hands while standing in her familiar short cape and belted dress. Large blossoms rest between her twin tails above her pointed ears. Small sleeve buttons, earrings, boot cuffs, and distant bushes add details around the open clothing shapes.

pages.title: Fern Waking a Sleepy Frieren in Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern wakes a sleepy Frieren in this printable coloring page, gently touching her shoulder while the elf sits in bed and rubs one eye with a hand. Frieren wears a long nightshirt beneath her blanket. The bedposts, pillow, window, wooden staff, and broad fabric folds create distinct sections in the indoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frieren and Himmel with Blue Moon Weed Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren and Himmel stand among blue moon weed flowers in this printable coloring page, with Himmel holding up a small blossom for the elf to examine. Frieren carries her crescent staff beside him. His cape, sword, boots, and tunic fastenings contrast with her short cloak and the large flowers around their feet.

pages.title: Flamme Teaching Young Frieren Flower Magic Coloring Page
pages.description: Flamme teaches young Frieren flower magic in this printable coloring page, shaping floating blossoms between her hands while the smaller elf watches with her staff held close. Flamme's tied-back hair and draped robe contrast with Frieren's short cape. Large petals, earrings, robe folds, and boots give the mentor scene distinct coloring sections.

pages.title: Frieren Catching a Stille Bird in Her Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Frieren catches a small Stille bird in this printable coloring page, cupping both hands beneath its folded wings while her crescent staff rests against a nearby rock. The bird's beak, feathers, and small feet remain visible. Her cape, twin tails, belted dress, and the simple tree trunk provide broad shapes around the central interaction.

pages.title: Fern Meeting Serie for Her Mage Interview Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern faces Serie for her mage interview in this printable coloring page, standing with her wooden staff before the ancient elf seated on a high-backed throne. Serie rests her chin on one hand with her legs crossed. A tall arched window, a small stack of books, flowing hair, and robe folds complete the interior.

pages.title: Fern Cleaning Laundry with a Magic Spell Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern cleans laundry with magic in this printable coloring page, holding her wooden staff as an empty shirt and T-shirt float above a large woven basket beside her. Curving trails and small sparkles outline the spell. Buttons, sleeve openings, basket bands, long hair, and the broad robe panels provide clearly separated coloring areas.

pages.title: Fern Holding Her Wooden Magic Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern holds her wooden magic staff in this printable coloring page, standing calmly in her long dress and open coat with both hands around the diagonal shaft. Straight hair and blunt bangs frame her face. Staff grain, simple fastenings, robe folds, and low bushes add small details around the broad costume shapes.

pages.title: Young Fern Practicing Outside Heiter's Home Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Fern practices magic outside Heiter's home in this printable coloring page, gripping a small staff as a narrow ray points toward a rock near the cottage. Heiter watches behind her in his priest robes. A round door handle, tree branches, long dress folds, and boots distinguish the training scene.

pages.title: Fern Casting Zoltraak with Her Wooden Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern casts Zoltraak from her wooden staff in this printable coloring page, spreading her boots into a steady stance as an outlined ray extends past the staff tip. Both hands grip the same diagonal shaft. Her long hair, wide sleeves, coat panels, and a low stone wall add separate sections around the spell effect.

pages.title: Fern and Stark Dancing in Ballroom Outfits Coloring Page
pages.description: Fern and Stark dance together in this printable coloring page, wearing a flowing ballroom gown and formal jacket while holding one pair of hands at shoulder height. Her free hand rests on his shoulder as his other arm supports her back. Dress folds, coat fastenings, shoes, and an arched window frame the pair.

pages.title: Stark Holding His Large Battle Axe Coloring Page
pages.description: Stark holds his large battle axe in this printable coloring page, standing with both hands around its long shaft while wearing his collared coat, belt, trousers, and boots. The two broad blades stay prominent beside his spiky hair. Shoulder straps, coat fastenings, cuffs, and simple rocks provide smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Stark Fighting the Solar Dragon with His Axe Coloring Page
pages.description: Stark confronts the solar dragon in this printable coloring page, gripping his axe in a wide battle stance while Frieren watches behind him with her staff. The dragon spreads two wings above its four legs and curling tail. Canyon rocks, axe blades, boot seams, and the dragon's teeth distinguish the action scene.

pages.title: Himmel Holding His Sword in His Hero Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: Himmel holds his sword in this printable coloring page, standing in a long cape and belted hero outfit with one hand resting near his waist beside the buckle. The straight blade points down beside his boot. Cape folds, tunic fastenings, a round guard ornament, and low bushes separate the broad shapes of the portrait.

pages.title: Himmel Pulling at the Sword in the Stone Coloring Page
pages.description: Himmel tries to pull a sword from a stone in this printable coloring page, gripping its hilt with both hands while planting his boots apart beneath his cape. The blade remains embedded in the rock. His bent elbows, tunic fastenings, sword guard, and simple forest setting make the attempted pull easy to recognize.

pages.title: Eisen with His Horned Helmet and Battle Axe Coloring Page
pages.description: Eisen holds his battle axe in this printable coloring page, wearing a broad horned helmet and layered armor above his naturally short dwarf legs and sturdy boots. His long beard covers much of the chest. Rounded shoulder plates, wrist guards, belt panels, and the single broad axe blade provide distinct coloring sections.

pages.title: Heiter Wearing His Long Priest Robes Coloring Page
pages.description: Heiter stands with his hands clasped in this printable coloring page, wearing long priest robes and glasses beneath swept-back hair beside a low stone wall and bushes. A short shoulder cape and paired round fastenings frame his chest. Long robe panels, sleeve cuffs, shoe outlines, and a simple tree branch add smaller details.

pages.title: Flamme Holding an Unrolled Magic Scroll Coloring Page
pages.description: Flamme holds an unrolled magical scroll in this printable coloring page, gripping its two rolled ends in front of her draped robe and sash with both hands. The parchment's center remains blank. Long tied-back hair, rectangular earrings, robe folds, small shoes, and a partial stone arch add details around the broad scroll shape.

pages.title: Serie Sitting on Her Throne with Spellbooks Coloring Page
pages.description: Serie sits on her throne among spellbooks in this printable coloring page, resting her hands on its armrests while crossing her legs beneath a simple wrapped outfit. Her pointed ears and long tousled hair frame the portrait. The tall throne, geometric finials, closed book covers, and layered fabric provide a mix of coloring areas.

pages.title: Ubel Casting Her Slashing Spell with a Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Ubel casts her slashing spell in this printable coloring page, holding a long staff diagonally across her body as two broad curved effects sweep past her dress and boots. Her side ponytail and short cape remain clearly visible. Belt holes, cape edges, staff ornaments, and the open spell shapes add smaller enclosed sections.

pages.title: Denken Conjuring a Magical Whirlwind Coloring Page
pages.description: Denken conjures a whirlwind in this printable coloring page, raising one open hand beside wide curling wind trails while holding a tall wooden staff in his other hand. His beard, mustache, and long coat distinguish the mage. Branch-like staff contours, sleeve folds, simple fastenings, and boots provide varied shapes without a detailed background.

pages.title: Kanne Controlling a Swirling Water Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: Kanne controls a swirling stream of water in this printable coloring page, spreading both hands beside a broad curved ribbon and several separate droplets near her short cape. Goggles rest above her short hair. Her belted travel outfit, small pouch, shorts, knee contours, and strapped boots add enclosed details around the flowing water.

pages.title: Lawine Creating Three Magical Ice Arrows Coloring Page
pages.description: Lawine creates three magical ice arrows in this printable coloring page, extending one open hand while holding her crystal-topped staff beside a long frilled coat and dress. Small braids frame her face beneath straight bangs. Angular arrowheads, staff fittings, coat buttons, and boot cuffs contrast with the broad fabric and hair sections.

pages.title: Aura Holding Her Scales of Obedience Coloring Page
pages.description: Aura holds her Scales of Obedience in this printable coloring page, raising a ring above the connected beam and two hanging pans beside her long layered dress. Curved horns rise above her paired braids. Chain links, fitted costume panels, sleeve edges, and boots provide smaller details around the broad figure and balanced scale.

pages.title: Sense Controlling Her Long Hair with Magic Coloring Page
pages.description: Sense controls her long hair with magic in this printable coloring page, standing with both hands open as thick outlined strands sweep around her formal robe and boots. The large curls remain separate from her arms. A short shoulder cape, neck ribbon, belt, and long fabric panels add enclosed sections around the flowing hair.
